sections.title: Form and habitat
sections.text: Alder buckthorn (Frangula alnus) is a deciduous shrub or small tree of wet woods, bogs and stream margins. It is usually 2–5 m tall and may reach about 7 m.

sections.title: Flowers and fruit
sections.text: Small greenish flowers appear in leaf axils from May to September. The 6–8 mm drupes ripen successively from green to red and then black.

sections.title: Toxicity
sections.text: The berries can cause nausea, vomiting and digestive upset. Do not eat them.
